name: Boss Behind the Scenes Is My Husband
original_name: Boss Behind the Scenes Is My Husband
overview: The leader of the most powerful Storm Cloak disguised himself as a blind man to investigate the cause of his father's death, and got married during the process. However, the wife seems to have quite a lot of enemies. Whatever! She’s my wife now and I’m going to spoil her anyway! Anyone who had bullied her before will suffer!
